definition: A public filing that records intellectual property rights a participant reasonably and personally knows may cover a Contribution to the IETF. It must name the patents or applications, the inventors, the document or activity affected and the Internet-Draft version, and it is filed at the IETF rather than inside the document itself.
plainLanguage: The official public note saying which of your patents might apply to a piece of work the IETF is doing.
